description: This file provides in-memory, volatile implementations of a state machine storage provider and the storage itself, intended for development and testing scenarios within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: VolatileStateMachineStorageProvider
classes.description: Provides a cache-backed, in-memory storage provider for state machine data, keyed by grain ID.

classes.name: VolatileStateMachineStorage
classes.description: Implements a non-persistent, in-memory storage for state machine segments, supporting read, append, replace, and delete operations.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates or retrieves the in-memory storage for a given grain context.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously reads all segments as log extents, supporting cancellation.

methods.name: AppendAsync
methods.description: Appends a new segment built from a LogExtentBuilder, supporting cancellation.

methods.name: ReplaceAsync
methods.description: Replaces current segments with a new snapshot, supporting cancellation.
